messages.content: Calculate the compounded interest for a principal amount of $10000, with a annual interest rate of 5% for a period of 3 years.

function.name: calculate_mortgage_payment
function.description: Calculate the monthly mortgage payment given the loan amount, loan term and annual interest rate. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

loan_amount.description: The loan amount in USD. This is a float type value.

annual_interest_rate.description: The annual interest rate in percentage. e.g. 3.5 for 3.5% This is a float type value.

message.content:
The compounded interest earned on a principal of **$10 000** at an annual rate of **5 %** over **3 years** (compounded once per year) is:

\[
A = P(1+r)^t = 10\,000 \times (1+0.05)^3 = 10\,000 \times 1.157625 = 11\,576.25
\]

Interest earned:

\[
I = A - P = 11\,576.25 - 10\,000 = \boxed{\$1\,576.25}
\]
message.reasoning:
The user wants compounded interest for principal $10,000, annual interest rate 5%, period 3 years. They didn't specify compounding frequency. Usually default is annually. So we can compute compound interest formula: A = P(1 + r/n)^(nt). If n=1, A = P(1+r)^t. Then interest earned = A - P.

So interest = 10000*(1+0.05)^3 - 10000 = 10000*((1.05)^3 - 1). (1.05)^3 = 1.157625. So interest = 10000*(0.157625) = 1576.25. So interest earned = $1,576.25.

We can provide that. No tool needed.
